children: Nigeria's economy expanded by 4.43% year-on-year in Q2 2026, the fastest pace since Q2 2021, accelerating from a 3.89% advance in the previous period.
The all-important oil sector powered the pickup, surging 7.31% from 2.57% in the previous period, as higher oil prices and supply constraints stemming from the US-Iran conflict supported activity.

The average daily crude oil production reached 1.72 million barrels per day in Q2, higher than 1.68 million bpd in the same period last year and 1.55 million bpd in Q1 2026.The non-oil sector also strengthened, expanding 4.31% from 3.94%, mainly supported by services (4.60%) and agriculture (4.39%), while industry grew 3.96%.

title: Nigeria GDP Growth Hits 5-Year High
